author: GamingBolt
description:
For veterans and wrestling aficionados, WWE 2K26's strong roster, engaging CM Punk Showcase, and raft of fantastical match types should satisfy your appetite. If you're a newcomer, leaning into the humour is perhaps your clearest entryway. 

Embrace the sheer daftness of it all, from electric arena walk-ins to throwing a road sign at someone’s head. WWE 2K26 is at its best when it's inside the ring, whether you're unloading power and technique at your opponent or just chasing irreverent humour.
title: WWE 2K26 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’re not going to lie. Victor Gideon was our favorite part of Resident Evil Requiem as early as the game's initial sections where he absolutely commanded the screen with his eerie way of talking, and the complete lack of hesitation he showed when escaping from Leon with Grace as his captive. 

We knew he was going to be a thorn in our heroes’ side, but we never imagined that his presence in the game could have far-reaching implications. And while Leon may have reduced his Nemesis form to a mound of pulp, we believe that the mad doctor's tale is far from over.
title: Resident Evil Requiem's Most Compelling Character Isn't the One You Think

author: GamingBolt
description:
Slay the Spire 2 has taken the gaming world by storm, breaking records and more than a few players’ resolve in a challenging yet massively entertaining sequel. But what has made it click so well, and so quickly? 

Join us as we dive into how the experience this one offers is designed to keep you coming back for more, or itching to get back to your gaming chairs in the event that you're called away from its entertaining gameplay loop.
title: Why Are MILLIONS Addicted To Slay the Spire 2?
